fieldValues.title: Full minutes do not strain the engine; they crowd search
fieldValues.summary: A year of monthly meetings kept in full is the size of repositories that validate in 0.4 seconds, but 52 per cent of a master's records after two meetings are working detail and a subject search returns mostly those.
evidence: srs-programme: 2,856 records, validate 0.41 s, find 0.36 s
Master after two meetings: 480 records, 251 working; find "fire escape" top ten: 3 open questions, 3 precedents, 1 fragment, 1 minute
The same search with --type-name minute: the right four
fieldValues.body: Bloat is a reading problem. Either the working layer stays out of the master, or discovery defaults to the outcome types.
